Not an identified causal coefficient; no rates enter actors.

spread.reason: Single generated-town calibration, independently drawn finisher validation pending. Income weight sensitivity 0.5 to 2 and wait pull 0.5 to 3 examined; this is a sensitivity window, not an empirical confidence interval.

renewalMedianPerVeryLowLimit.citation: HUD income limits: the very low-income limit for a family of four is 50% of the area median family income (HUD Income Limits methodology, https://www.huduser.gov/portal/datasets/il.html). The place's own HUD row gives its median, so the couple's income is read against what is usual where they live.

renewalJobWeight.citation: PW-8: stability of work. Each partner with a paying job adds this weight, centered on one earner. Direction: economic uncertainty and job loss delay births (Schneider 2015, Journal of Marriage and Family 77(5), 'The Great Recession, Fertility, and Uncertainty'). The size is tunable.

spread.citation: Checked against the full couples' decisions and the town's yearly births in two fresh played-world seeds.

renewalRoomWeight.citation: PW-8: room for a child. What one more bedroom costs a year at the place's HUD fair market rents, against household income, as a bounded share. Direction: higher housing costs lower births among renters (Dettling and Kearney 2014, Journal of Public Economics 110, 'House prices and birth rates'). The size is tunable.

spread.citation: Checked against the full couples' decisions and the town's yearly births in two fresh played-world seeds.

renewalConditionWeight.citation: PW-8: the mother's recorded chronic conditions from the health module weigh against planning a pregnancy, as a bounded share n/(n + 1). The size is tunable.

spread.citation: Checked against the full couples' decisions in two fresh played-world seeds.

renewalClosenessWeight.citation: PW-8: how close the partners are, from their relationship record (0 to 1; one half is the closeness model's midpoint), centered on that midpoint. The size is tunable.

spread.citation: Checked against the full couples' decisions in two fresh played-world seeds.

renewalUnknownCloseness.citation: PW-8: when partners have no relationship record yet, their closeness is estimated at the closeness model's midpoint (level 0.5, src/core2/closeness.ts levelFromHours), never zero.
renewalUnknownCloseness.estimatedFrom: Closeness model midpoint; the estimate weighs zero in the decision.

renewalUnionAgeYears.citation: PW-8: when a couple has no dated partner fact and no children, their start is estimated as the mother reaching the usual age of a first union. First unions for U.S. women mostly begin in the early twenties (CDC NCHS National Survey of Family Growth, first cohabitation and first marriage reports).
renewalUnionAgeYears.estimatedFrom: NSFG first-union timing for women; registered as SG-PW8-partnership-start until partnerships carry their own start date.

spread.citation: Early-twenties range of first unions; the timing term's shape is checked against it.
